verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for a hosted email service, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers data residency, region selection, or storage location controls for Gmail or Workspace. The pack covers only API sending, push notifications, scopes, add-ons, IMAP and Gemini features, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
